```sql
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           o.id  AS order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT product_id, order_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS q,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS r
      FROM base
     GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
per_product AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)        AS order_count,
           sum(q)::bigint  AS quantity,
           sum(r)          AS revenue_cents
      FROM per_order
     GROUP BY product_id
),
per_variant AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM base) v
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       pvc.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN per_variant pvc ON pvc.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN products p      ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY quantity DESC, revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De dure sortering van ~81k rijen op (product, order) naar schijf voor `count(DISTINCT)` verdwijnt. In plaats daarvan aggregeer ik eerst per (product, order) en per (product, variant) met hash-aggregaten. De join met `products` gebeurt pas na het aggregeren, op ruwweg 1.751 rijen. Types blijven gelijk: `quantity` blijft bigint via een expliciete cast en `revenue_cents` blijft numeric.
